readings: Across all accounts with at least one order, calculate the average number of orders per account. Return exactly 10 accounts with the largest order count minus that average, breaking ties by ascending account id. For each, show the account id, its branch district’s region, its order count, and the unrounded difference. Sort by difference descending, then account id ascending.

Across all accounts with at least one order, calculate the average number of orders per account. Return every account whose order count minus that average is at least as large as the 10th account’s difference, including all accounts tied at the cutoff. For each, show the account id, its branch district’s region, its order count, and the unrounded difference. Sort by difference descending, then account id ascending.
queries:
WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
average_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count
    FROM order_counts
)
SELECT
    oc.account_id,
    d.A3 AS region,
    oc.order_count,
    oc.order_count - ac.avg_order_count AS difference
FROM order_counts AS oc
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
ORDER BY difference DESC, oc.account_id ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
differences AS (
    SELECT
        oc.account_id,
        oc.order_count,
        oc.order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM order_counts) AS difference
    FROM order_counts AS oc
),
cutoff AS (
    SELECT difference
    FROM differences
    ORDER BY difference DESC, account_id ASC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
)
SELECT
    d.account_id,
    district.A3 AS region,
    d.order_count,
    d.difference
FROM differences AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.difference >= (SELECT difference FROM cutoff)
ORDER BY d.difference DESC, d.account_id ASC
